DIAGNOSIS READY: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis (Primary Hypothyroidism)

The elevated Anti-TPO and Anti-thyroglobulin antibodies, combined with your high TSH, anemia, and unrefreshing sleep, confirm an autoimmune attack on your thyroid gland. We can begin treatment with levothyroxine to replace your thyroid hormone.
